title: Weighted measurable curriculum-build index
description: A transparent weighted index across measurable system-building workstreams. It does not claim complete product readiness, learner mastery, CEFR/ETS certification or deployment acceptance.

denominators.related_glossary_join: distinct canonical relation target terms in current source
denominators.related_glossary_quality: all existing Related Glossary records; zero automated quality flags
denominators.objective_resource_mapping: all resource IDs in canonical objective map
denominators.outcome_evidence: all defined outcome criteria in objective-outcomes registry

exclusions: independent editorial approval and psychometric calibration
Mock exam approval and full 200-question coverage quality
remote GitHub Actions and Pages deployment acceptance
learner mastery and TOEIC score readiness
rules: Do not change denominators silently between releases.
Do not treat content inventory as evidence of accuracy or learning mastery.
Do not award coverage to unverified or review-pending content as editorially approved.
If a defensible denominator is unavailable, report the workstream as unmeasured and exclude it from this provisional index.
